quality.label: Quality setting for Tidal:
quality.description: The maximum streaming quality to request from Tidal.

option_descriptions.LOSSLESS: 16-bit / 44.1 kHz — CD quality, plays on any device.
option_descriptions.HI_RES_LOSSLESS: Up to 24-bit / 192 kHz — hi-res; needs a player/DAC that supports it.

auth_instructions.label: On the next page, open Tidal and sign in. Afterwards you land on a page that says 'Page Not Found' - that is expected. Copy the full URL from your browser's address bar and paste it in the step afterwards.

manifest.description: Stream music, playlists, and exclusives in lossless FLAC quality.
